role: ArchiveMigrations' deferred repairs: flag-gated index backfills (recovery score, endDate, meanHR/stress, sleep index fields), duplicate quarantine of same-night overnights, and re-linking of same-night split segments, plus the reupload notification name.
types: ArchiveMigrations: extension — migrations over SessionArchive state
ArchiveMigrations.RelinkWork: struct (private) — parent entry, file URL, ids to link
ArchiveMigrations.RelinkResult: struct (private) — new hash and link chain
toplevel: relinkEncoder and quarantineReadme static initialisers; Notification.Name.flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload = 'flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload'. The header says migrations are one-time, but runDeferredMigrations runs at every launch housekeeping and after every CloudKit pull.

units.does: Runs, in order: re-encryption of pending plaintext sessions, recovery-score/endDate/metrics/sleep-index index backfills, duplicate quarantine, and same-night relink. Each step takes/releases the archive lock itself.

flags.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says runDeferredMigrations runs '7 one-time passes ... at launch' and 'each is a no-op if already complete'; removeDuplicates and relinkSameNightSessions are deliberately not flag-gated and re-run every time, and the whole pass also runs after every CloudKit pull.

units.does: Flag-gated backfill of sleepEnd + sleepSegmentCount on entries where both are nil, from each session's sleep snapshot/stored segments.

Generic 3-phase backfill: returns 0 if its done flag is set; snapshots entries needing work + file URLs under the lock; loads each session lightweight without the lock and builds patches; applies patches under lock (hash-guarded) and saves; sets the done flag only when every session loaded. Returns patch count.

branches.effect: loadedAll=false (flag stays off; retried next launch) and continue
append it; nil means nothing to patch
set flag true; else leave unset

units.does: Decodes a session file through the dual-format loader with the lightweight (no rrSeries) decoder; logs and returns nil on any error.

Under the lock, replaces each patched entry only if the current entry's fileHash still matches the patch's (drops patches for sessions re-archived since phase 1), then saves the index (failure logged only).

branches.cond: entry still present AND hash unchanged

branches.effect: log and continue (in-memory index patched, disk index stale)

units.does: Builds a copy of the entry with sleepEnd/sleepSegmentCount from deriveSleepIndexFields and sleep mirrors from the session; nil when neither field resolves.
Flag-gated backfill of recoveryScore = session.readinessScore for entries with nil recoveryScore and non-nil meanRMSSD.

flags.text: recoveryScorePatch, endDatePatch and metricsPatch rebuild the entry through the memberwise init without sleepEnd/sleepSegmentCount (defaults nil) and mirroringSleepFields copies those two from the rebuilt entry (sleepEnd: sleepEnd), so every entry these migrations patch loses its wake time and split-night segment count. On a first pass migrateSleepIndexFields (run after them) refills them, but if the sleep-index flag was set on an earlier launch while one of these three kept its flag off (a session failed to load, loadedAll=false), the later patch nulls the fields and the done sleep-index migration never refills them: history shows recording-stop time instead of wake time and drops the split-night badge.

units.does: Rebuilds an entry with recoveryScore = readiness, endDate/meanHR/stressIndex filled from the session where nil, linkedSessionIds taken from the SESSION, then overlays sleep mirrors; sleepEnd and sleepSegmentCount are not passed and become nil.

Unlike the other patches, linkedSessionIds is taken from the lightweight-loaded session rather than the entry, so a link chain written into the index but not the file (or vice versa) is silently swapped.

units.does: Unless merge mode is .off: picks same-night overnight duplicates (≥85% contained in a better-ranked keeper, nights older than 24 h, unlinked), moves their files to QuarantinedDuplicates/ outside the lock, then under the lock drops their index entries, tombstones them with deletion times and saves both indexes (failures logged only).

branches.effect: log only; in-memory index lacks the entries, disk index still lists files that are now in quarantine
log only; tombstones exist only in memory and in deletion times

flags.text: Files are moved before the index saves; a failed save is only logged, so after relaunch the stored index points at moved files (fileNotFound on read) and, if deleted.json also failed, the duplicates lack tombstones.

units.does: Under the lock, runs the pure duplicatesToQuarantine over overnight entries (linked ids protected, current schedule/now/merge mode) and maps the chosen ids to their file URLs.
Ensures QuarantinedDuplicates/ (+README) exists and moves each work file there, returning the ids whose move succeeded.

branches.cond: for each work item where moveToQuarantine succeeded

units.does: Moves one session file into the quarantine dir, replacing an existing file of the same name; false when the source is already gone (another run moved it) or the move throws.

branches.effect: log 'already moved by another run' and return false

units.does: Pure: set of every id that links others plus every id it links, among the given entries.

branches.effect: skip; else insert the entry id and its links

units.does: Pure: groups overnight entries by night anchor; for nights with >1 unlinked entry and no entry younger than dedupeSafetyWindow (24 h), returns ids of losers ≥85% contained in the keeper.

branches.cond: for each night with more than one entry
any unlinked entry younger than 24 h

flags.text: The 24-hour recency predicate is written inline here and again as hasRecentEntry for relink.

units.does: Pure: ranks a night's entries (has recoveryScore > has meanRMSSD > later start) and returns ids of the non-keepers whose ranges are mostly inside the keeper's; [] when the keeper has no endDate.

branches.cond: exactly one of the pair has a recoveryScore

branches.effect: that one ranks first; else later date first

units.does: Pure: true when the loser's span is ≥ duplicateContainmentRatio (0.85) overlapped by the keeper's, or (zero-length loser) its start lies inside the keeper; logs and returns false otherwise.

branches.effect: return true; else log overlap % and return false

units.does: Creates the quarantine directory if missing and writes README.txt (once) with UntilFirstUserAuthentication protection; failures logged.

branches.effect: log and return (moves will then fail individually)

units.does: Builds per-sleep relink work, rewrites each parent's file under the lock with missing links appended, and posts flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload with the changed ids.

Under the lock: groups overnight entries by night anchor, skips single-entry nights and nights with an entry younger than 24 h, splits each night into sleeps by the merge gap (0 when merge mode .off), and makes a work item per sleep with >1 recording.

branches.effect: gap = 0 (only touching/overlapping recordings form one sleep); else the user's merge gap

units.does: For one sleep's entries: latest-starting entry is the parent; others become ids to link. Nil for a single recording.
Pure: true when any entry started less than dedupeSafetyWindow (24 h) before now.

Under the lock: skips the work if the parent entry vanished or its hash changed since phase 1; otherwise relinks (rewrites the file), replaces the entry with the new hash + links and saves the index (failure logged only).

branches.cond: parent missing, hash changed, or relink returned nil

flags.text: The parent's file has already been rewritten (new bytes, new hash) when saveIndex is attempted; a failed save is only logged, so the persisted index keeps the old hash and after relaunch every read of that night fails verifyHash (hashMismatch) until the sync push path happens to call repairSessionHashIfDecodable.

units.does: Loads the parent with the full decoder, appends work.otherIds not already linked, writes it back and returns the new hash + link chain; nil when nothing to add or load/write failed.
Decodes the parent file with the full sessionDecoder via the dual-format loader; logs and returns nil on error.
Encodes with relinkEncoder (encrypt if available), writes with format-dependent protection options (ledger updated), returns hash of bytes-as-written; logs and returns nil on error.
Static JSONEncoder with iso8601 dates and prettyPrinted+sortedKeys output used for relinked files.
Copies every field of the old entry, replacing fileHash and linkedSessionIds with the relink result.
